Extracting structured semantic information from unstructured text is essential for many AI tasks, including knowledge discovery, knowledge base maintenance, symbolic representation, reasoning, and planning. Beyond these applications, a growing number of NLP tasks now explicitly require structured outputs as part of their formulation. Some examples are code generation, SQL generation, constituency parsing, and various information extraction.
